caption: The worked example on one timeline: the 100 s run is 20 s serial plus 80 s parallel. With 16 processors the parallel part drops to 5 s, giving 25 s total (speedup 4, efficiency 0.25), while the same 20 s serial block stays put as the floor.

spec.aria: A timeline of the worked example: one processor runs 20 s of serial work then 80 s of parallel work for 100 s total; with 16 processors the same 20 s of serial work is followed by only 5 s of parallel work, so the run ends at 25 s.
